Message:
rtw89: handle TX/RX 160M bandwidth

Apply 160M bandwidth to RA (rate adaptive) mechanism, so it can transmit
packets with this bandwidth. On the other hand, convert 160M bandwidth
from RX desc to rx_info_bw.
